# Overall model fit with best fitting parameter

```{r}

# Put infant data in grouped means format
grouped_infant_means = infant_data %>% group_by(test_type, fam_duration) %>% dplyr::summarize(LT = mean(LT))


# only keep parameters for which all fam durations have been computed
model_data <- model_data %>%
  group_by(param_id, trial_type) %>%
  filter(all(1:10 %in% trial_number)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(test_type = trial_type) %>%
  mutate(fam_duration = trial_number - 1,
         test_type = case_when(test_type == 'background' ~ 'fam', test_type == 'deviant' ~ 'nov')) 

# remo fam duration = 0 to when deviant
model_data = model_data %>% filter(!(test_type == 'nov' & fam_duration == 0))

# combine model with data
combined_df = model_data %>% mutate(fam_duration = as.integer(fam_duration)) %>%
  left_join(grouped_infant_means, by = c("test_type", "fam_duration")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(LT)) 

# group by parameter info and find groupwise intercept and slope
grouped_stats <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(param_id) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(LT ~ mean_sample, data = .))) %>%
  select(-c(std.error, statistic, p.value)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  spread(term, estimate)

# merge with intercept and slope and scale the samples
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  left_join(grouped_stats, by = c("param_id")) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(intercept = "(Intercept)", slope = mean_sample.y, n_samples = mean_sample.x) %>% 
  mutate(scaled_samples = n_samples * slope + intercept) %>% select(-n_samples)

# compute per param_setting correlation and sort by max corr, and select
top_corr_param = combined_df %>% group_by(param_id) %>% dplyr::summarize(corr = cor(scaled_samples, LT), rmse = rmse(LT, scaled_samples)) %>% arrange(desc(corr)) %>% pull(param_id) %>% first() 

top_sim_result = combined_df %>% filter(param_id == top_corr_param) 

plot_df = top_sim_result %>% dplyr::rename(`Infant behavior` = LT, `RANCH (infants)` = scaled_samples) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("RANCH (infants)", "Infant behavior"), names_to = "value_type", values_to = "value") %>% 
  mutate(value_type = factor(value_type, levels = c("Infant behavior", "RANCH (infants)")),
        test_type = ifelse(test_type == 'nov', 'Novel', 'Familiar')) 

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = fam_duration, y = value, color = test_type, group = test_type)) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", size = 2) +  geom_point(size = 3)  + ylab('Looking time (s)') + xlab('fam duration') +  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,1,2,3,4,6,8,9)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3, 10, 30)) + xlab('Exposure duration') + labs(color = 'Test type') + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 25)) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,35)) + facet_grid(~value_type) + theme_classic(30) + scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "red"))

  

```


# Crossvalidation
```{r}

infant_data = infant_data %>% mutate(subj_id = paste0(experiment, subject_num))

param_ids = sample(model_data$param_id,3)
model_data = model_data %>% filter(param_id %in% param_ids)

full_k_fold_res <- lapply(
  unique(model_data$param_id), 
  function(id){
    run_subject_wise_crossvalidation(p_id = id, 
               raw_d = infant_data, 
               sd = model_data)
  }
) %>% 
  bind_rows()


```
